title: Vaporesso Vibe Nano Pod Kit
description:
The
Vaporesso Vibe Nano Pod Kit
is a compact square-shaped pod system with Dual Mesh Smart Pod technology that switches between two coil resistances using a simple mode slider. Features an RGB display showing mode and battery level.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
1100mAh
Wattage:
ECO 12W / PWR 20W (Dual Mode Slider)
Charging:
USB Type-C (1A)
E-Liquid Capacity:
4.5mL
Coil Type:
Integrated Dual Mesh (Smart Pod Technology)
Coil Resistance:
1.0Ω/0.6Ω Dual Resistance Pod (included)
Activation:
Draw-Activated (No Buttons)
Airflow:
Auto-Adjusting (Mode-Dependent)
Display:
RGB Colour Screen (Mode + Battery)
Chipset:
AXON
Fill Method:
Side Fill
Pod Compatibility:
All Vaporesso Vibe Pods
Brand:
Vaporesso
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
Available options: Black, Blue.
